data.gender_notes: Ineshika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ineshika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ine’ which means ‘Goddess’ and ‘Shika’ which means ‘auspicious sign’. This name is believed to bring blessings of the Goddess and signify good luck and prosperity. The name Ineshika carries the meaning “Goddess Ine's Auspicious Sign” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ineshika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess ine's auspicious sign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ineshika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Ine's Auspicious Sign.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ineshika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
